<subject>Catherine Storey for Corporate Transactions Closing Protocol</subject>
<body>
I talked to each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this topic got pushed aside due to some other pressing issues. However, each of you agreed that a standard transaction closure window was acceptable for M&A, advisory and structured finance matters.

The best option will be to agree to close submissions at 3pm each day (just to get an idea of the numbers we were talking about, I looked at yesterday to determine how many transactions were logged after 3pm London time. We had three corporate advisory matters, and two compliance-related filings). After 3pm, the case management system would automatically roll new Corporate matters to the next working day. However, for those transactions that do not close after 3pm, the various practice groups would need to remember that these matters are the following day's business. I am not sure how the procedures in our Finance & Operations division would need to be modified for the partner position reports, as the official docket would not include these late submissions. Can Finance & Operations run supplemental reports to ensure that the teams have accurate workload allocation each morning?

I would appreciate any comments that you may have, and regardless, please re-confirm that a closure window of 3pm works for each of your respective groups.

Danielle Saunders
Vice President
Meridian Law & Advisory LLP
+44 20 7946 2857

Eric - any potential problems with the billing reconciliation?
Mary - we discussed briefly a few weeks back...any thoughts?
</body>
